task: Send direct visits to the OpenBao and Velero UI root through the same-origin /sso bootstrap so zero-click Keycloak SSO also works from bookmarks and ClusterDeck links (PR #472). Scope: the two ApisixRoute rules, R281 and the docs; the rules were already deployed to Kakao through Gitea before this trace.

events.summary: Two ApisixRoute rules (openbao-sso-entry for /, /ui, /ui/; velero-ui-sso-entry for /) that 302 to /sso only without a query string, plus R281 (scripts/test/lib/check-sso-direct-entry.py), the SSO permission matrix and a lessons-log row. No chart version, client or RBAC change. Branch brought up to date with main by a merge (no rebase).
Before the rules, a direct visit to the app root stopped at the app's own login screen because the zero-click flow only ran via /sso (PR #472 description, kakao APISIX access log).

Added the two entry rules with the same security headers as the catch-all; D-ssoentry-1 records the cost (one Keycloak round trip on a root reload) and the escape hatch (any query string, OpenBao manual token login at /ui/vault/auth?with=token).
